Rider's Tent

Pick a people for a stranger, or shape one yourself: clothes, hair and beard, skin and hair colour, body and face. Drag to turn, scroll to step closer.

The character as data: body, clothes per slot, hair and beard, skin and hair colour, the morph sliders (−1 to 1), ancestry shares, the people it was drawn from, and any dye. A city can store one of these per citizen. Roll a stranger draws from the people picked on the Head tab.

Bodies, clothes and much of the hair: MakeHuman and its community assets (CC0), fitted with MPFB2. CC-BY: hair by Elvaerwyn, punkduck, culturalibre, grinsegold, WojackOWL and brkurt; beards by Elvaerwyn, grinsegold and WojackOWL (MakeHuman community asset packs and repository). See CREDITS.md.
